rowFilter.users.last_activity_at.name: last_activity_at
rowFilter.users.last_activity_at.description: When the application last OBSERVED activity for this account: NULL means never observed. Never backfilled and never defaulted — see 0017 §1. A NULL row is never eligible for the dormant-account purge (authz.retention_due_accounts requires IS NOT NULL), because a measurement that was never taken cannot show that an account is dormant.

rowFilter.users.first_name.name: first_name
rowFilter.users.first_name.description: The member's given name as THEY state it. NULL means nobody has stated one — it is never derived from username or email and never defaulted. Blank and untrimmed values are refused by users_first_name_not_blank: ' ' is an absent answer dressed as one, and 'CA ' is a right answer that will never compare equal to 'CA' in the predicate that depends on it.

rowFilter.users.last_name.name: last_name
rowFilter.users.last_name.description: The member's family name, as THEY state it. Same rules and same CHECK shape as first_name: NULL when unstated, never defaulted, never blank, never untrimmed.

rowFilter.users.last_login_at.name: last_login_at
rowFilter.users.last_login_at.description: When this account last passed a CREDENTIAL check: NULL means no successful authentication has been recorded, which is NOT the same as never having signed in. Distinct from users.last_activity_at (0017), which is any observed activity. Never backfilled, never defaulted, and written from the login path's own now() rather than from a caller.

rowFilter.users.disabled_by.name: disabled_by
rowFilter.users.disabled_by.description: The administrator row that made this decision, or NULL for an automated block. ON DELETE SET NULL: this is a pointer AT a person, not a row owned by the disabled account, so deleting an administrator must not cascade into anybody's account — and must not be refused either, since an erasure that cannot complete leaves the erasure half-done. A NULL actor is legal only when disabled_reason explains the decision (users_disabled_requires_actor_or_reason).

rowFilter.users.disabled_reason.name: disabled_reason
rowFilter.users.disabled_reason.description: WHY the account was disabled, from the closed vocabulary ('admin', 'security', 'compliance', 'user_request') enforced by users_disabled_reason_check. A value outside the list is invisible to every reader of this column and reported by nothing, which is why it is a CHECK and not a comment.

rowFilter.users.disabled_until.name: disabled_until
rowFilter.users.disabled_until.description: When a TEMPORARY disable expires; NULL means the disable is not temporary and lasts until somebody lifts it. Nothing expires it automatically: this records when a suspension was MEANT to end, and a sweeper that acts on it is application work. users_disabled_until_after_disabled_at keeps the two timestamps ordered.

rowFilter.consent_page_groups.authentica.name: authenticated_only
rowFilter.consent_page_groups.authentica.description: TRUE for groups that only exist inside an authenticated session, so a new route is covered by being a route rather than by being listed.

rowFilter.consent_tags.snippet.name: snippet
rowFilter.consent_tags.snippet.description: Opaque to this migration. No vendor is named, recognised or hardcoded anywhere in this file.
